d:
The song "Mere Jhumkon Ne Chum Liya Gaal" from the 1995 Bollywood film Ab Insaf Hoga is a lively and playful track that showcases the charm and elegance of the lead actresses, Shagufta Ali and Sahila Chadda. The song is sung by Sadhana Sargam and Poornima, with lyrics penned by Anand Bakshi and music composed by the duo Anand-Milind.
